title: Close out the test-performance epic: retro, then the follow-on packages
description:
Run the epic-close retro, then decide what the remaining parallelism work is worth: internal/runstate (2 t.Setenv call sites) and internal/cli (25, plus 2 os.Chdir) were deliberately left out of x73 as follow-ons rather than blockers.

Record in the retro the number this epic exists for: the gate ran 49 times during epic-9pd, at roughly 20 minutes idle and 45-60+ under load. Say what it costs now, measured the same way.
